scenicChapters.title: Creole Nature Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 16 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Creole Nature Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: For 15 km this is Creole Nature Trail, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

creole-nature-trail.story: A 183 km loop that starts and ends near Lake Charles, about 2 h 57 of riding. It goes by way of Sulphur, Holly Beach, Cameron and Creole. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
